title: Constraint: Two Groups of Ones
constraints: The set bits of `v` (16 bits) form exactly **two** separate groups (runs), for example `0011_1000_0110_0000`.
Every group is at least **two** bits long.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: A run starts where a bit is 1 and its lower neighbour is 0: `v & ~(v << 1)`. Count those. Verilator's constraint-to-SMT translation mis-sizes shift operators on vectors narrower than 32 bits (z3 then rejects the query and `randomize()` fails). Use part-selects and concatenation instead: `v >> 1` becomes `{1'b0, v[15:1]}`.
An isolated one has zeros on both sides: `v & ~(v << 1) & ~(v >> 1)`. There must be none.

examples.check: the ones form exactly two groups
examples.title: valid

examples.check: every group has at least two ones
